_doc: The kind table of workflows-core:document-lineage. One row per document kind. match: basename regexes. covered: true where producers record upstreams and the walk reads this kind's own record. reviser: the command that revises this kind when it is the stale downstream. version: 'header' where the kind's header carries '- **Version**: N', else null. items: start-line regexes, one capture group = the item id, with a nesting level (ids that restart under a parent are keyed by their full path). notes: heading regexes opening a section excluded from comparison until the next heading of the same or a higher level. ignore_lines: line regexes excluded from comparison. Text outside every item is compared per '## ' section. altitude: on a downstream kind, the altitude it consumes; a link into it leaves out every upstream item whose live copies all carry another. item_altitude: on an upstream kind, a regex whose one group reads an item's altitude, matched only at the item's own id-key column. ignore_fields: field names excluded from comparison inside an item, each with its continuation lines (those indented past the item's key column), read only at that column. section_altitude: '## ' section heading -> the altitude its own text carries, read by the altitude filter as an item's is. drop_sections: regexes over a '## ' section heading's text; a section whose heading one matches has its own text excluded from comparison; an item-start line inside one still opens an item. skip_items_in: {file, field}: a file beside the upstream, read at the ref, whose '<field>: [ID]' lines name items left out of comparison; missing or unreadable, it names none. _source: where each row was measured.
